params.name: model
params.description: The Prisma model name (e.g., user, post, comment) as defined in the Prisma schema file

params.name: where
params.description: JSON-encoded filter conditions using Prisma query operators

params.name: orderBy
params.description: JSON-encoded sort specification with field names and asc/desc

params.name: take
params.description: Number of records to return. Negative values reverse the order.

params.name: skip
params.description: Number of records to skip for offset pagination

params.name: cursor
params.description: JSON-encoded cursor position for cursor-based pagination

params.name: select
params.description: JSON-encoded field selection specifying which properties to include

params.name: include
params.description: JSON-encoded relation loading specification for eager loading

params.name: distinct
params.description: JSON-encoded list of fields to deduplicate results by

items.docs: Retrieves multiple records from the specified model with optional filtering, ordering, pagination, and relation loading. Supports where conditions with operators (equals, contains, startsWith, endsWith, gt, gte, lt, lte, in, notIn), orderBy on any field, cursor-based and offset pagination via take/skip, and distinct filtering.
